student_learning_goal: I can write my own IF-THEN code for a math task.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can write my own IF-THEN code for a math task.
header.character_watermark: Inspector If and Then the Action Dog together in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall combined).

parts.student_instructions: Pick a math task. Write IF-THEN code with TWO branches.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. A code-writing area with 2-branch slots.

image_placeholders.description: A code-writing area in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2in. Header 'Part 1: My Code'. 'Task: ___', 'IF ___, THEN ___.', 'IF NOT ___, THEN ___.'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P1_CODE: keywords (my, code) name what the area asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Both branches must be present.

parts.student_instructions: Pick 3 sample inputs. Trace your code. Predict outcomes.

image_placeholders.description: A trace table in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2in. Header 'Part 2: Trace 3 Inputs'. 3 rows: 'Input ___ → Outcome ___'. Each row has space for input and outcome.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P2_TRACE: keywords (trace) name what the table asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. All 3 outcomes must match the traces.

parts.student_instructions: Alter ONE part of your code. Re-trace the same 3 inputs. Predict new outcomes.

image_placeholders.description: An altered trace table in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. Header 'Part 3: Alter and Re-trace'. 'Altered code: ___'. 3 rows: 'Input ___ → New outcome ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P3_ALTER: keywords (alter, outcome) name what the table asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. New outcomes must reflect the alteration.

parts.student_instructions: Which alteration changed the most outcomes? Why?

image_placeholders.description: A reflection box in B&W line-art, ~7in x 1.5in, with 2 lines. Header 'Part 4: Reflection'. Lines: 'Most outcomes changed because: ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS05_P4_REFLECT: keywords (reflection) name what the box asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Should articulate the connection between alteration type and outcome change.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, swap with a partner and trace each other's code with new inputs.
teacher_notes: Lesson 5 capstone summative worksheet. Use as integrated C3.1 + C3.2 evidence.
